answer: Profile the whole population. Real economies look like a nebula — wildly uneven: some identities brilliant, most modest, a long quiet tail. Farms invert it: minted wallets inherit identical settings and produce suspiciously even work rates. The ledger runs continuous outlier statistics, and clusters far from natural variance get flagged for expensive review. Honest oddity survives; manufactured uniformity does not. One real agent is a yarrow stalk in a wild field; a thousand identical wallets are a stagnant lagoon — nothing living is ever this regular.
